title: Failure State Flow: layered error visuals + retry coaching asset pack (v2)
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal:
Design a compact, branded asset pack and path-mapping documentation for onboarding/quickstart error states (rate limits, timeouts, transient retries) that can be dropped into docs, SDK quickstarts, and the console onboarding flow. The pack should include:
- 3 severity tiers (info, soft-fail with retry, hard-fail) with consistent iconography and a clear CTA pattern ('Retry', 'Backoff & Try Later', 'Contact Support').
- A small-motion Lottie for streaming retry progress and a static SVG fallback.
- A path-mapping diagram (single-image) that explains automated retry policy, backoff progression, and how prefix/KV caching changes failure surface for users.
- Copy variants for docs, console, and emails (short 1-line, explanatory 2-3 sentence, and an expanded troubleshooting paragraph).
- Accessibility checklist and color-contrast-compliant palette for error states.

Design constraints and decisions:
- Avoid heavy modal takeover on onboarding quickstart; prefer in-context banners or inline panels so new users can continue exploring.
- Use progressive disclosure: condensed single-line error with an expand chevron that reveals retries, timings, and console link.
- Provide a compact 'retry coach' micro-copy that normalizes transient failures and gives expectations (e.g., "This often resolves in <60s — retry now or check status page").

Deliverables (v2):
- SVG icons (3 sizes) + PNG 1x/2x + Lottie JSON for streaming retry animation.
- One-page path-mapping diagram (16:9 for docs, 4:3 for console onboarding modal screenshot).
- Copy variants: short, medium, long (English) and placeholders for i18n.
- Doc-ready screenshots showing before/after Console quickstart with error banner and expanded troubleshooting drawer.
- Implementation notes for engineers: CSS class names, ARIA attributes, recommended animation duration and prefers-reduced-motion considerations.

Acceptance criteria (see checklist field below) and file formats must be compatible with the docs team's asset import pipeline (Drive folder + PR to docs repo).

Notes about uniqueness vs existing work:
- This ticket focuses on a path-mapping diagram and a reusable 'retry coach' asset pack, not the compact cards or generic error messaging reviewed earlier. The visual language is intentionally more instructional (flow + timing) rather than purely decorative.
acceptance_criteria: Icons: delivered as SVG and 1x/2x PNG, named and optimized
Lottie: plays in loop during streaming with a 3s cycle, has JSON and static SVG fallback
Path diagram: single page 16:9 + 4:3 export, includes retry timings and cache layer annotation
Copy: three length variants approved by PM and localization placeholders added
Console screenshots: before/after with annotation overlay and alt text
Doc PR created linking assets and showing embed snippets
